headline: The Financial Times asks whether AI can help the world deal with the very strong El Niño that has been nicknamed “Godzilla.”
score_reason: Lowered by 1: only the question the Financial Times poses is known, not its findings; the El Nino context is confirmed elsewhere.
importance_line: A record El Niño will shape this winter's weather for many people, so any tool that improves forecasts matters to households, local governments and businesses planning ahead, but whether AI can do that for an unprecedented event is only the question posed.
summary: The Financial Times asks on 17 Oct 2026 whether AI can help the world deal with the very strong El Niño nicknamed “Godzilla.” Gizmodo reported on 16 Oct 2026 that this is the strongest El Niño on record and still intensifying, and that neither scientists nor climate models have seen an event of this size, which may complicate forecasting its effects.
notes: Headline only for the FT piece; El Nino context from Gizmodo (https://gizmodo.com/new-maps-show-how-drastically-this-years-super-el-nino-could-influence-winter-weather-in-the-us-2000826901). Syndication parameter removed from the FT link. Desk-built entry.
